definitions.explanation: A test format where students write their own answers in sentences or paragraphs, rather than choosing from given options. Requires the ability to organize and express thoughts in writing.

examples.japanese: この{試験|しけん}は{記述式|きじゅつしき}だ。
{記述式|きじゅつしき}の{問題|もんだい}は{時間|じかん}がかかる。
{選択式|せんたくしき}だけでなく{記述式|きじゅつしき}の{問題|もんだい}も{出題|しゅつだい}されるので、しっかり{準備|じゅんび}してください。
examples.english: Not only multiple-choice but also essay-type questions will be given, so please prepare thoroughly.

notes: Compound of {記述|きじゅつ} (description/writing) + {式|しき} (style/format). Contrasts with {選択式|せんたくしき} / マークシート{式|しき} (multiple-choice format) and {穴埋|あなう}め{式|しき} (fill-in-the-blank format). Common collocations: {記述式|きじゅつしき}の{問題|もんだい} (essay-type question), {記述式|きじゅつしき}{試験|しけん} (essay-type exam). In Japanese education, there has been ongoing debate about introducing more {記述式|きじゅつしき} questions into university entrance exams.
